newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche intends to stick with core business.
newsitem.headline: Roche intends to stick with core business.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said it had no plans to diversify and any possible acquisitions would be within its core business areas.
"We have no intention of diversifying," Roche chairman Fritz Gerber told a news conference, adding the company would focus on its core business in any possible acquisitions.
Gerber was responding to a reporter's question about Roche's acquisition strategy.
"We concentrate on our own strengths," Gerber said, ading: "In those areas where we are active, we want to be belong to the leaders."
